explanation: This method uses unsafe SQL string construction (CWE-89) by interpolating commentid via %d before passing sqlText to sql.queryDB(). Although %d restricts formatting to integers if commentid is numeric, building SQL strings dynamically risks injection if refactored or coerced differently. The repair replaces %d with a %s placeholder and passes params=[commentid] separately, though complete safety depends on the unseen sql.queryDB implementation.
